introHtml: Sublimation printing allows for full-color, all-over designs that won't peel or fade — ideal for baby onesies, bibs, and toddler tees. Unlike standard screen printing, sublimation dyes bond with polyester fabrics, giving you soft, breathable garments with vivid graphics that last through countless washes. Whether you're creating matching sets for a company picnic or personalized gifts for new parents, sublimation delivers sharp logos and bright patterns that babies and toddlers love to wear.
